turns.doctor_question: Have these blank spells ever happened while you were asleep or just waking up?
turns.patient_response:
While I'm asleep? I'm not really sure how I would know if my mind goes blank while I'm sleeping. I mean, you're unconscious, right? So you wouldn't know. I guess I don't really remember my dreams most of the time anyway. Sometimes I'll wake up and know I had a bad dream, but I can't remember any of the details. Just this lingering feeling of dread, like I forgot to do something really important. 

I hate that feeling. It's like when you leave the house and you're halfway down the street and you suddenly panic because you can't remember if you locked the front door or turned off the stove. I do that with my curling iron all the time. I'll actually turn the car around and drive all the way back home just to check, and it's always unplugged. I should really just start taking a picture of the unplugged cord on my phone before I leave, but then my camera roll would just be hundreds of pictures of a curling iron on a bathroom counter. My phone is already out of storage space anyway. It keeps giving me that annoying pop-up message saying I need to manage my storage, but I don't want to delete any of my pictures. I have all these photos from a trip I took to the Grand Canyon like ten years ago. It's so beautiful there, but the lack of guardrails is terrifying. You just walk right up to the edge and look down. I felt dizzy just standing there. 

But um, no, I haven't noticed them happening when I'm waking up or anything. Just mostly when I'm awake and trying to do things.
